gaps.term: Distinctness of primes for equal padded lengths
gaps.quote: Windows for padded lengths that differ by a factor of two are disjoint when $\eta<1/4$, so the chosen primes are distinct
gaps.note: The disjointness argument covers only padded lengths differing by a factor of two. Axes with the same padded length share one window, and the page gives nothing preventing the independent choices from picking the same prime, so distinctness does not follow as stated.
